real-font-measurement-v1.contract: Measure with the same font family, weight, tracking and line-height used for rendering.

headline-fit-monotonic-v1.contract: For identical content and geometry, Large >= Default >= Small. A larger intent must never render smaller.

split-shared-headline-v1.contract: Both equal-status Split panels use one shared computed headline size; longer copy wraps naturally.

list-content-fit-v1.contract: Fit list content within the approved scale floor and preserve overflow/line warnings.

list-header-connected-placement-v1.contract: List starts from measured header bottom plus bounded offset; it is never independently vertically centred.

playmap-art-direction-v1.contract: Map Clean/Playful/Poster to deterministic hierarchy, composition and graphic behaviour per template.

real-font-measurement-v2.contract: FontFaceSet.load must succeed; same full typography specification and native width on visible and untransformed hidden DOM.

headline-fit-monotonic-v2.contract: One content/geometry fit capacity for all intents. Large >= Default >= Small. Constrained targets warn. Fixed typography across intents.

list-content-fit-v2.contract: All primary/secondary/third content measured. Shrink primary from 46 to 32px; metadata >=21 and third >=20. Infeasible rows warn, no truncation/omission advertised as success.

list-header-connected-placement-v2.contract: Rows begin after actual measured headline/subheading bottom plus the composition-owned gap.

list-composition-v2.contract: Resolve a List-specific registered composition from the shared recipe.

list-clean-composition-v2.contract: Paper editorial index, fine rules, restrained tabs.

list-playful-composition-v2.contract: Teal expressive header, structural route/rail, offset colourful blocks on paper.

list-poster-composition-v2.contract: Yellow count-led header, diagonal band, teal body, oversized numerals and two-column rhythm.

lovable-restored-layout-v1.contract: Preserve source composition from ec495d3; image and numbering choices remain bounded.

restored-real-font-measurement-v1.contract: Bundled real fonts, exact rendered typography, explicit font readiness before fitting.

restored-monotonic-headline-v1.contract: Identical geometry and shared typography fit capacity across all size intents; Large >= Default >= Small.

restored-split-shared-headline-v1.contract: One headline size for both Split panels; natural wraps and separate supporting-copy fit.

restored-list-header-connected-v1.contract: Source header-connected layout, footer and actual motif safety.

restored-list-content-fit-v1.contract: Source count/density/column metrics, 0.8 floor and per-item line warnings.

cover-transparent-frame-v1.contract: Bottom composition uses canvas width + natural height, bottom=0; corner uses right=0/top=0, natural height and bounded width. Preserve transparent frame; never square-fit, stretch or trim it.

cover-stable-graphics-v2.contract: Main and optional additional graphic preserve independent uploads and intrinsic aspect ratios. Four corner anchors are available. Copy uses the source lower-zone reservation across empty/loading/loaded/removed states. Pixel overlap is diagnostic only, never a headline-fit input.

cover-copy-space-v1.contract: Explicit copy allocation: preserve v4 lower image reservation or use expanded height. Asset state never selects copy allocation. Overlap is diagnostic only.

curated-visual-above-v1.contract: One full-width visual above a number tab bridging into dominant copy. Media type never selects geometry, number or wordmark behaviour. Fit/focus affect only the visual.

curated-complete-copy-fit-v1.contract: Measure hook/detail/complete metadata with their visible typography. Reserve their actual height before fitting the title. Retain every field; warn on minimum-size or whole-copy overflow.

list-headline-budget-v1.contract: Measure the same list rows at the minimum allowed scale with loaded fonts. Allocate headline height from real remaining geometry; this capacity is shared across size intents. Items follow measured header height.

list-exclusive-footer-v1.contract: The chosen footer is CTA, graphic or none. An inactive uploaded graphic cannot reserve space or overlap a CTA. If minimum-scale rows do not fit, report overflow and do not silently clip them at the list zone.

list-strong-type-v1.contract: Item weights 700/900; number weight 900 with stronger numerals. Plain numbers use the foreground on light palettes for legibility.

curated-two-compositions-v1.contract: Visual-above panel remains available; visual-below has dominant upper copy and bottom-anchored composed artwork. Neither medium nor load state selects layout. Frame fitting preserves natural aspect ratio/transparency.

curated-strong-metadata-v1.contract: Measure the suburb and price independently at matching 42px target support typography; use a high-contrast price tag. Reserve actual metadata-row height before title fitting.

curated-copy-density-v1.contract: Fit and visual density are separate: more than 7 copy lines or more than 3 title lines warns, while every field remains visible.

list-readable-third-v1.contract: Third line uses stronger 600 weight, .95 opacity, and larger 34/32/28 base sizes by density. The same row markup drives measurement and visible fitting.

curated-number-options-v1.contract: Filled pill, plain numeral or outlined circle share a stable anchor in both treatments. Approved colour or automatic contrast; number choice never changes copy geometry.

curated-aligned-price-v1.contract: Left price stacks below suburb at the headline left edge; right price reaches the text right edge. Reserve the actual chosen metadata geometry before title fitting.

curated-copy-protection-v1.contract: For lower composed frames, an explicit soft alpha mask reduces image opacity to .08 under actual measured copy, restoring full colour 130px below. Upload metrics and pixels never alter copy fitting.

list-readable-third-v2.contract: Retain strong 600/.95 third line but use 29/26/23 base sizes below secondary34/30/27. Every count/column/fit scale must keep primary > secondary > third.

curated-number-options-v2.contract: Optional number. Style-owned font sizes and lighter 3px outline leave breathing room around two digits. Plain numeral aligns left. No number releases its copy spacing.

curated-optional-price-v1.contract: Empty or hidden price reserves no space. Plain price or filled tag aligns to the chosen copy edge. Reserve exact variant metadata height before fitting headline.

curated-copy-hierarchy-v1.contract: Headline dominant; hook36/600; detail30/500; suburb and price28/600. Supporting and metadata roles have bounded minimum sizes; overflow warns.

curated-copy-protection-v2.contract: Feathered background-colour scrim follows actual copy top/bottom and horizontal bounds with modest padding. Image remains full-colour outside this local region. No pixel analysis or asset measurements drive copy fitting.

curated-number-options-v3.contract: Pill and outlined circle remain compact badges. Plain number is a line inside the headline stack, inheriting its full display typography and alignment; None remains available. Colour choices are retained.

curated-headline-number-fit-v1.contract: Measure the plain number plus newline plus title together with the real headline face, width, tracking, weight and line-height. Reserve a16px gap; one computed size applies to both. Shared-capacity monotonic intent remains.
